role: XCTest suite for SessionArchive storage integrity on a private temp directory: archive/retrieve, SHA256 hash, duplicates, re-upload notifications and modifiedAt stamping, trash, deletion, tags, concurrency, batch archive, integrity verification, encrypted repair, deleting from the Trash for good (deletion mark, outcome, breadcrumb route, pull of a forgotten session), the sealed index, nearby-session detection and edge cases.
types: ArchiveIntegrityTests: class — XCTestCase over a hermetic SessionArchive (more tests in ArchiveIntegrityTests+Codec.swift)
state: mem:ArchiveIntegrityTests.archive (lazy SessionArchive with injected 22:00/8h schedule, .defaultGap merge mode, 4.5h merge gap)
toplevel: archiveDirectory is a per-instance temp URL; archive is a lazy SessionArchive(directory:archiveDirectory, schedule 22:00+8h, mergeMode .defaultGap, mergeGap 4.5h) so tests do not depend on SettingsManager. Class setUp pins NSTimeZone.default to UTC and warms static singletons. Imports CloudKit for the pull test's CKRecord.
